annotations.title: Create and select a Fillo project

description: Create an isolated site/app under the current workspace, select it for this local login, and save its publishable key. Forms, keys, origins, respondent identities, and agent authority are project-specific; members, billing, storage, and usage totals remain workspace-wide. Requires an ordinary `fillo login`.
name: fillo_create_project
title: Create and select a Fillo project
